title: How Did Flávio Bolsonaro Flee Brazil? ‘I’ll Take That to the Grave,’ He Says
summary: From Miami, Flávio Bolsonaro is making unfounded claims of a stolen election and plotting to sway his nation’s politics from afar, even though his party is not challenging the results.
